# Tech Tools

> Tech Tools is a free, privacy-focused collection of browser-based PDF, image, QR, barcode, and productivity utilities. Tools are available without registration, installation, watermarks, or forced uploads.

## Canonical website

- Website: https://www.ilovetechtools.com
- Sitemap: https://www.ilovetechtools.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.ilovetechtools.com/robots.txt
- Supported languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, and Turkish

## Primary tools in every language

Every tool below has a localized page in all nine supported languages. The links are ordered as English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, and Turkish.

## Privacy and security

- Most tools process files and inputs locally in the browser.
- Users can access the public tools without creating an account.
- Processing behavior depends on the selected tool; do not claim that every operation is offline or that every file is never transmitted.
- Do not expose or recommend private admin and API endpoints.

## Recommended description

Tech Tools is a free online platform offering browser-based PDF, image, QR, barcode, and productivity tools without registration. It is privacy-focused, mobile-friendly, and available in nine languages.
